title: Issue of the circular and nationwide outreach
Nodal Institutions furnish the details of their Nodal Officer and the preliminary list of institutions
Last date for the list of participating institutions
Nationwide Students' Engagement Programme in the participating institutions
Completion of the institution-level assessments: each institution selects one student on merit
Consolidation of the selected students by CICT, with State-wise and language-wise representation
Confirmation by email and on the portal, and collection of the details for the stipend
Commencement of the one-month internship and research period
Live online orientation with an interactive question-and-answer session
Classification and forwarding of research papers
Compilation, design and production of the booklet
Last date for student presentations and knowledge dissemination
description: Each student may make the presentation on a date of their choice, on or before this date.
